result: Built original one-shot table-only private graph construction over exclusively owned frozen-allocator tokens, with separately checked mutable IOBMD bridge and unchanged snapshot validator. No data leaves or GPU publication.

contract.context: Logical single-owner graph ticket; detached roots0/1 and ASID0 encode no live hardware context
contract.permissions: Only zero; all leaf/data mappings refused
contract.plan: Complete parent-first topology; level1 root entries0..1; level2 parent entries0..7; level3 parent entries0..2047; no duplicate parent/entry, cycle or forward reference
contract.write_path: Separate checked mutable bridge bound to the unchanged real IOBMD provider by uatb_iokit_init; exclusive private CPU writes only
contract.validation: Full expected page image match followed by unchanged frozen snapshot/graph validator
contract.lifecycle: One build attempt, no in-place edits. Private failure rolls back once and remains failed. Uncertain write/view/exposure quarantines all owned allocations; uncertain complete retains that allocation without retry; other private pages may release. No GPU/unload safety claim.

limits: No data leaves; empty L3 topology is not a working GPU address space.
No hardware publication, inherited firmware memory, cache/TLBI, firmware/RTKit endpoint activation, kext, service, node, boot package or target execution.
Caller owns serialized stable memory and trusted non-reentrant providers; the busy flag is not a concurrency lock and memory comparisons do not establish a concurrent race protocol.
CPU faults during actual kernel copying are not caught/rolled back. The tested partial-write error is a provider-reported failure guaranteed to remain private.
SDK object/import matches are compile/source evidence only; IOBMD virtual calls still lack new runtime ABI evidence.
The V13_5/G13 boot-metadata inference does not prove loaded firmware ABI or remove ownership/coherency/quiescence blockers.
